pool.text: Chandradeva, founder of the Gahadavala dynasty, made Banaras a second capital.
The current ghat as a permanent riverside embankment was built.
Kabir was born in Varanasi during this year.
Guru Nanak visited Varanasi for Maha Shivaratri.
The Jantar Mantar observatory was constructed above the ghats along the Ganges.
Balwant Singh regained control of territories and declared himself Maharaja of Benares.
A centuries-old Durga idol was installed in Purana Durga Bari by Kali Prasanna Mukhopadhyay.
The Golden Temple was built by Queen Ahilyabai Holkar of Indore.
A separate Ayurvedic College was established in Banaras Hindu University.
Mahatma Gandhi inaugurated the Bharat Mata Mandir dedicated to national personification.
The Bharat Sevashram Sangha was founded in Varanasi.
Prime Minister Indira Gandhi established a Doordarshan Kendra in Varanasi.
The temple at the birthplace of Ravidas was completed.
A Doordarshan studio was set up in Varanasi.
The airport was granted international airport status in Varanasi.
A new inland port was established on the banks of the Ganges River.
The sale of meat was banned within 250 meters of all Varanasi temples and heritage sites.
Narendra Modi inaugurated the Shri Kashi Vishwanath Corridor project in Varanasi.
The Kashi ropeway has been under construction in Varanasi.
The sale of all meat was banned in Varanasi during Navaratri.
